g.text: 11. Adjuncts — combination and second-line drug PK

g.text: 12. Drug PD — Nav blockade and downstream effects

g.title: Genetic_pred
g.text: Genetic predisposition (familial TN, some autosomal dominant)

g.title: Pulsatile_compression
g.text: Pulsatile mechanical compression (synchronised with the cardiac cycle)

g.title: MS_plaque
g.text: MS plaque at the pontine trigeminal entry zone

g.title: Tumor_assoc
g.text: Tumour compression (cerebellopontine angle tumour, epidermoid cyst)

g.title: REZ
g.text: Trigeminal root entry zone (REZ) compression site

g.title: Focal_demyelination
g.text: Focal demyelinating lesion at the REZ

g.title: Myelin_biomarker
g.text: MRI FIESTA/CISS findings of compression and demyelination

g.title: Ephaptic_crosstalk
g.text: Electrical leak between demyelinated axons (ephaptic transmission)

g.title: Light_touch_trigger
g.text: Light touch to the trigger zone → pain provoked

g.title: Disease_progression
g.text: Progressive worsening of paroxysm frequency / intensity

g.title: Atypical_TN
g.text: Atypical TN (TN2) with continuous background pain

g.title: Bilateral_TN
g.text: Bilateral TN (points to a secondary cause)

g.title: Nav_blockade
g.text: Use-dependent block of voltage-gated Na+ channels

g.title: GABAB_activation
g.text: GABA-B activation → enhanced inhibitory synaptic transmission in spinal cord / brainstem (baclofen)

g.title: CaV_alpha2delta_block
g.text: α2δ subunit binding → reduced CaV current (gabapentinoids)

g.title: BoNTA_pk
g.text: Botulinum toxin A, subcutaneous facial injection

g.title: SNARE_cleavage
g.text: SNAP-25 cleavage → neurotransmitter / CGRP release inhibited (BoNT-A)

g.title: CorneaAE
g.text: Loss of corneal reflex → exposure keratitis (when V1 is involved)

g.title: Refractory_flag
g.text: Medically refractory (failure of two or more agents)

g.title: Autonomic_features
g.text: Accompanying autonomic features (tearing / conjunctival injection, atypical TN)

g.title: Diagnostic_MRI
g.text: High-resolution 3D MRI (FIESTA/CISS) to confirm neurovascular contact

g.title: Functional_disability
g.text: Functional disability / job loss and reduced social activity

g.title: Sumatriptan_acute
g.text: Sumatriptan (experimental use in an acute attack)
